Chapter 6737: One Night More Than Li Qiye

Chapter 6737: One Night More Than Li Qiye

Other immortals were silent after the result of the heavenly scale.

“Your Golden World will accept the dao infusion?” An immortal asked.

“Yes.” The person shrouded by the radiance said decisively.

“Boom!” His word was a mantra so the primordial energy immediately poured into this world.

It affected the vast golden ocean but the scale still accepted it. Just like that, one of the nine major worlds gained primordial energy.

Golden laws rooted themselves in the new energy, crafting a dao source in the process.

Li Baye didn’t care for approval and continued to send trees and primordial energy to all worlds. He and his real tree served as the medium to craft new dao sources for cultivation.

In just a short time, all worlds became filled with primordial energy. Cultivators found that they could cultivate again through primordial energy.

Many were moved to tears, finally appreciating what they had before. The ancient ancestors and emperors rejoiced more than the others.

As they tried again, they found their merit laws compatible with primordial energy. Previously, they cultivated using other affinities and thought they would have to use new merit laws.

In actuality, Talisman World kept its talisman system. Metal World could still use the core merit laws. Heavenly Demons kept their hidden gift system...

Some finally understood what Li Baye meant - how the laws would follow the people. The system was recrafted but didn’t change in practice. The only difference was the use of primordial energy instead of another source.

In just one night, everyone knew Li Baye’s name. As cultivators picked up the pieces, they gradually forgot his real name and called him by new titles- The Enlightener or Eternal Sacred Teacher.

In the future, cultivators of all realms spoke of him with utmost respect. This frustrated Li Baye since he wanted everyone to know he had one more night than Li Qiye.

“My name is Li Baye, that’s one more night compared to Qiye.” He complained to an immortal once.

“Yes, Sacred Teacher.” The immortal said respectfully.

Li Baye felt the urge to break the immortal’s head open and shout his name again.

Alas, everyone still addressed him by his official titles, not his name. Eventually, he gave up and only mumbled to himself about how he was superior to Li Qiye.

Just like that, worlds entered another cultivation stage. Of course, chaos also came with the sudden destruction of the previous dao.

Powerful cultivators and alliances struggled to keep up with the changes. Thus, some took advantage of this to perform nefarious deeds undetected.

***

An immortal traveled in stealth, intending to devour a minor world. He opened his mouth and sucked in time.

He tried to mask it as a temporal explosion. If anyone were to see it, they would think this was natural destruction.

The major worlds were in disorder; no one had the time to spare for this tiny world.

“Dregs of Devouring Alliance, still around?” Someone interrupted him.

He turned back and saw an old man with a white beard, looking simple yet enlightened.

The old man sat not far behind him, picking up a stone and sharpening the hatchet in his hand.

The weapon looked like an ordinary woodcutter’s tool but could make immortals shudder. After all, it could easily decapitate them.
